title: Line of Duty: Evaluating LLM Self-Knowledge via Consistency in Feasibility Boundaries
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It evaluates an LLM's self-knowledge regarding its own capabilities, including ethical boundaries, but does not use religious topics as test cases.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. The main findings are that LLMs misjudge their capabilities at least 20% of the time, struggle with contextual awareness and temporal perception, and show confusion between functional and contextual limitations.
